title: OA Studio notification envelope
description: Written by any OA Studio agent, delivered by the orchestrator. Agents never hold chat ids or bot tokens: the orchestrator maps destination.route to a chat and topic (for site:healthguide-cy, the HealthGuide.cy topic of 'OA Studio · Command Center').

id.description: Unique; the orchestrator treats a repeated id as already delivered

level.description: critical: send now; warning: send now, no repeat while dedupe_key is unchanged; info: may be batched into the next digest

text.description: Plain text, ready to send; no Markdown or HTML, so no escaping is needed

dedupe_key.description: Same key as the previous notification for this route means nothing changed
